summary: Reusable DluxLoadingButton spinner helper (declarative + promise + task-polling) with login/register and dynamic-modal migration; loading spinner preserves a button's icon/text layout in place. Inline-updater UX fixes: green Finish on success, honest status (no false 'update completed' after a check), spinning Check button, translated up-to-date/ready line. Frontend-only (JS/CSS/templates), no migrations; inline-safe.
